annotations.title: Moscow Exchange stock quote (delayed ~15 min): price, change, volume, bid/offer

description:
Moscow Exchange stock quote (delayed ~15 min): price, change, volume, bid/offer. One MOEX shares-market ticker from MOEX ISS (main board TQBR when listed): price (last trade, or previous close before the session's first trade), change/change_pct vs previous close, open/high/low, bid/offer, volume, value_rub, market cap, trading status. Data is delayed ~15 minutes (delayed: true). Unknown ticker -> 404 (not settled).

GET /moex/quote — price $0.003 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

ticker.description: MOEX ticker (SECID) on the shares market, e.g. SBER, GAZP, LKOH, YDEX, T
